design: Frozen adjective-last-subtoken MLP3 local/total factorial intervention formulas and periodMLP4 native write rescue from H973/974. Fit no sites or encoder. Recompute quartet algebra from new teacher activations; this tests site/formula transfer, not a frozen learned featurizer. All64 quartets included; passing native cohorts interpreted separately.
controls: Identity, +/- norm-matched random upstream factorial edits for local and total; +/- norm-matched random period correction for each ablation; native-period rescue identity.
metrics: Valence-aligned margin loss and native-reference KL; recovery of ablation loss after period rescue, KL remaining. Multi-subtoken adjectives patched only at last subtoken, per frozen convention.
limits: Small cohort sizes, teacher-informed and potentially off-manifold edits, shared lexicons across templates. No training or reserved-test access.
